SELECT `School Name`, `District Type`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'
  AND a.atom_id IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR001_10'
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR001_11'
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM bond b;
SELECT code FROM sets WHERE type = 'commander';

SELECT id
FROM sets
WHERE type = 'commander'
ORDER BY totalSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams' AND l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'A Lion');

SELECT DISTINCT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Matt Parker' AND v.PostId > 4;

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'North Pole' AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Blue' AND c2.colour = 'Blond';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Gold' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.gender_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero s 
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id 
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT d.number
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 903
  AND q.q3 LIKE '0:01:54%';

SELECT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Brands Hatch' AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name, rs.points
FROM races r
JOIN driverStandings rs ON r.raceId = rs.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON rs.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year, r.round
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) FROM results WHERE raceId = 18;

SELECT driverId
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(r.points)
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races rac ON r.raceId = rac.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON rac.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND c.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix';
SELECT AVG(height) FROM Player WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00' AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND pa.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.long_passing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT AVG(p.height) FROM Player p JOIN Country c ON p.player_fifa_api_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY m.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP = '2+'
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.phone = '809-555-3360';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE event_date LIKE '2019-%';

SELECT (SUM(e.cost) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.link_to_budget)) AS percentage
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.type = 'Meeting';

SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) / 12.0 AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312';
